protocol.horizon: Complete chip window (GW19/GW38), plus four terminal weeks; never the end of the scored interval
protocol.execution: Production learned_forecast → full-market multiweek optimize → independent transition/scoring → next observation
protocol.models: Reference refit each deadline on completed earlier labels; recovery and joint-DGW gates frozen before each evaluation period
protocol.prices: Observed next-deadline prices update lots; future prices stay fixed as in the production primary forecast
protocol.initial: Identical £100m ownership seed and chip inventory; GW1 permits unlimited initial selection and grants one FT for GW2
protocol.track: Historical statistical reconstruction; imported corrected labels, not prospective or blindly untouched research

recovery.target: Transition from published injured/doubtful status to published available status; not an inferred medical diagnosis

rotation.scope: Conditional next-match minute-band test with earlier calibrated fit; production conditions on simulated previous minutes, never future actual minutes

joint_validation.scope: Exact production density-ratio transition over all 16 joint states, against freshly refitted earlier-only production minute forecasts; no realized first-match input

availability.protocol: Recovery: fit before 2024/25 GW25, calibrate that season remainder, test 2025 onward. Rotation: 2022/23 fit, 2023/24 calibrate, 2024/25 onward test; four-deadline block intervals and independent joint-DGW gate.
